job.title: [Post] ... looking for a Salesforce OMS Architect who can design end-to-end order ... Salesforce…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Order Management & Integration Specialist | Java & Spring Expert
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience designing and supporting complex order management and e-commerce ecosystems for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and data pipeline optimization. I bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, leveraging AI-assisted development to ensure high-performance, scalable solutions for complex order flows and platform migrations.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce OMS Architect
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in the OMS Architect role at Shakir Rai. With over 5 years of experience delivering large-scale e-commerce and order management solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in complex integration architectures and backend platform development.

bullets.label: Order Management Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive experience managing the SAP Commerce Order Management (OMS) module, designing end-to-end order flows, and ensuring data consistency across complex enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Integration Architecture
bullets.text: I specialize in designing and building robust data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring seamless synchronization and high-performance API integration.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I operate effectively between business and technical teams, translating complex business requirements into functional specifications and scalable technical solutions.

bullets.label: Platform Performance
bullets.text: I have a proven track record of optimizing database queries and API performance, ensuring system stability and reliability for high-traffic e-commerce platforms.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is in SAP Commerce Cloud, my deep background in complex order management, API-driven architecture, and enterprise-level integration provides a strong foundation for designing high-performance order systems.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period and will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to Shakir Rai for your focus on complex, end-to-end order management solutions. My background in high-stakes e-commerce environments, where I have managed intricate data flows and integration bottlenecks, aligns perfectly with your commitment to architectural excellence. I am eager to bring my experience in building scalable, robust order systems to your team and contribute to the continued success of your enterprise-level projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by solving complex integration challenges and designing scalable order management architectures that drive business efficiency and seamless customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am an SAP Commerce & OMS specialist with 5+ years of experience in enterprise integration. I am interested in the OMS Architect role at Shakir Rai and would love to discuss how my background in complex order flows can support your team. Best, Kranti Chavan.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Salesforce OMS Architect - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find my CV and cover letter attached for the OMS Architect position. With over 5 years of experience in enterprise e-commerce, order management, and complex system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am based in Germany, hold a valid work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of an interview.
